correctness.rationale: Conditional uniformity within dyadic bands under both maps and full band history induces the Markov level transition: k>=1 to k-1 with p and k+1 with q; from k=0, q to 1 and p reinject geometric J with Pr(J=j)=2^-j-1. Stationary PGF Pi(z)=d/((2-z)(p-qz)) yields mean p/d, Var=(1+7d²)/(4d²) and third moment. Check quadratic h(k)=k(k-1)/(2d) solves (I-P)h=k-p/d, including reinjection at k=0 using E[J(J-1)]=2. Martingale decomposition and geometric Foster drift establish stationary CLT; sigma²=2E[gh]-E[g²] reduces to displayed rational expression. At p=1 renewal to level0 remains ergodic, sigma²=6; at p=1/2 excluded because no stationary ac law. Independent SymPy identities checked PGF, boundary/interior Poisson equations, exact variance and critical scales (finite matrix numerics not necessary for infinite proof).
residual_risks: Bounded independent tests corroborate but do not themselves prove the infinite-parameter theorem.
